scenarios.definition: Wave 2 stimulus-006 bytes reused verbatim with C-BOUND2 (max=2 on quote_requested_one); 2 observed <= 2 max so no cardinality finding
scenarios.derivation: occurrence_bounds.quote_requested_one.max = 2; observed count is 2; 2 > 2 is false. All ordering, property and forbidden checks pass. Zero findings.

scenarios.definition: four POSTs: three, one, three, zero; C-VALID max=1 for three, 2 observed; ordering satisfied by existence semantics
scenarios.derivation: occurrence_bounds.quote_requested_three.max = 1; 2 > 1 is true. Ordering: three.must_occur_after_any=[one]; one at position 1, three at positions 0 and 2; some(p>1) holds at p=2. No wrong_order.

scenarios.definition: Wave 1 001 sequence plus quote_requested_cancel; C-FORBID-INFO declares cancel as forbidden with severity info
scenarios.derivation: forbidden_events[0].event = quote_requested_cancel, severity = info. Rollup over {info} yields pass, so runStatus is clean. One finding emitted.

scenarios.definition: Wave 1 001 sequence plus one event-less body; C-VALID reused. Fourth request has no event field, causing partial health
scenarios.derivation: Fourth request matches URL but has no event field; unsupported > 0 => health partial. partial not in UNHEALTHY, eligible.length = 3 != 0 => checks run. Three events satisfy C-VALID. Zero findings, clean, partial.
